title: Farm, Swamp, Sektur & 10,000 Trees of Strife — Biblical, Subcultural and Network Atlas
purpose: Integrate recovered Farm/Swamp/Sektur mythology with public history of 4chan, Encyclopedia Dramatica, lolcow culture and Kiwi Farms; connect Farmer/Dog/Cow roles with Tree of Knowledge, serpent, fall, Moloch, holy/unholy cow symbolism, extraction, anonymity, contagion and the 10,000 Trees of Strife while separating factual claims about people from project mythology.
epistemic_rule: Empirical statements about real websites/people must be sourced and narrowly stated. Josh Moon = Moloch and the 10,000 Trees of Strife are Potatoverse mythic interpretations, not factual accusations that he is literally a deity or personally caused every harm associated with the ecosystem.

recovered_project_architecture.core_chain: unresolved soil → Shadow/Strife/Mud trees → Sektur → Farmers → Dogs → circles/feedback → Swamp
recovered_project_architecture.farm_chain: person → exposure → documentation → reaction → secondary content → conflict → archive → monetization/status → repetition

role_definitions.Cow: enclosed or repeatedly observed subject whose reactions/content are made harvestable
role_definitions.Lolcow: internet slang for a person treated as a recurring source of amusement/content and often deliberately provoked
role_definitions.Farmer: operator who maintains enclosure, indexing, incentives and extraction
role_definitions.Sektur: closed loyalty/enemy-construction layer; faction becomes identity-enclosure
role_definitions.Swamp: emergent ecology of incentives, mud, repetition, institutions and feedback loops
role_definitions.Tree of Strife: self-reproducing branch structure of suspicion, humiliation, conflict, resentment and fragmentation
role_definitions.Tree of Life: counter-structure of nourishment, relation, cultivation, repair and generativity

4chan.facts: 4chan launched in 2003 as an anonymous English-language imageboard inspired by Futaba Channel/2chan. Its anonymous culture became highly influential in Western internet memes and subcultures; the site has also been associated with raids, harassment and offensive/illegal content controversies.

encyclopedia_dramatica.facts: Encyclopedia Dramatica launched in 2004 and functioned as a troll-culture wiki/archive documenting memes, raids and internet drama in an intentionally offensive style.

lolcow.facts: 'Lolcow' is derogatory internet slang, documented by 2007, for a person regarded as repeatedly exploitable for amusement; the metaphor derives from 'milking' a recurring supply of laughs/content.

kiwi_farms.facts: Kiwi Farms, formerly CWCki Forums, emerged from a forum ecosystem centered on extensive discussion/documentation of an individual internet figure and later expanded to many targets. Public sources identify Joshua Moon as founder/owner. The site has been widely described by journalists and reference sources as associated with harassment, stalking/doxing controversies and organized trolling; Moon and the site have disputed or rejected some characterizations and responsibility claims.

anonymity_psychology.finding: Experimental and review research finds anonymity/online disinhibition can increase trolling or cyber-aggressive behavior in some settings; effects are probabilistic and interact with individual/contextual variables.

josh_moon_project_layer.empirical: Joshua Moon is publicly identified as the founder/owner of Kiwi Farms.
josh_moon_project_layer.potatoverse_myth: Prior project mythology casts Josh Moon as a Farmer who becomes Moloch and grows 10,000 Trees of Strife on an internet Farm.
josh_moon_project_layer.interpretive_meaning: This is best read as an archetype of an operator whose platform/incentive system can be interpreted as converting attention, humiliation and reaction into durable branching archives and communities.
josh_moon_project_layer.boundary: Do not state that Moon literally performs child sacrifice, is literally Moloch, or personally authored every act of users. The Moloch mapping is symbolic/systemic.

moloch_layers.biblical_scholarly: Molech/Moloch appears in biblical prohibitions associated with passing children through fire. Scholarship debates whether mōlek referred principally to a deity, a sacrificial rite/category, or intertwined cultic concepts. Ancient Near Eastern child-sacrifice contexts are historically contested in detail but well-established as a serious scholarly field.
moloch_layers.modern_systemic_archetype: Modern internet writing sometimes uses 'Moloch' metaphorically for coordination failures or competitive systems that consume valued futures because individually rational actors cannot escape destructive incentives.
moloch_layers.project_use: Farm-Moloch = system that converts future human possibility into present attention/status/extraction; this is an incentive-system metaphor, not historical identity with biblical Molech.

biblical_textual_structure: Garden contains Tree of Life and Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil.
Human eating produces changed knowledge/self-awareness, shame, relational rupture and expulsion from Eden.
Access to Tree of Life is then blocked in the narrative.

project_crosswalk.farm_model: environment of cultivation / rules / available fruits
archive/documentation/knowledge that can enlighten or weaponize
project_crosswalk.potatoverse: knowledge without nourishment can become Strife
signal that opens a Door toward a different rule-system
handshake with a new information regime

project_crosswalk.farm_model: loss of access to regenerative/nourishing path

genesis_tree_serpent_fall.boundary: Genesis does not historically refer to internet forums; these are project structural comparisons.

knowledge_tree_duality.insight: The same archive/tree form can nourish or harm. The difference is not 'knowledge vs ignorance' but purpose, relation, extraction and consequence.
knowledge_tree_duality.life_tree: knowledge → discernment → responsibility → nourishment → growth → further life
knowledge_tree_duality.strife_tree: knowledge → exposure → provocation → humiliation → retaliation → documentation → more exposure
knowledge_tree_duality.key_question: What does the tree metabolize, and what fruit does it produce?

cow_atlas.biological_cow: domesticated cattle; social mammals used historically for milk, labor, meat and agricultural value

holy_cow.meaning: In Hindu traditions, cattle—especially cows—became deeply associated with nonviolence, nourishment, motherhood, prosperity, Krishna/cowherding and sacred protection, though the historical development is complex and not timelessly uniform.

cow_atlas.red_heifer: distinct biblical purification-sacrifice motif already indexed elsewhere; cow/heifer can symbolize costly purification rather than amusement/extraction
cow_atlas.golden_calf: biblical idol/false-worship comparator; cattle image becomes object of devotion rather than nourishment
cow_atlas.lolcow: internet extraction metaphor: a person treated as a recurring producer of reactions/laughs/content to be 'milked'
cow_atlas.unholy_cow: Potatoverse working category for a cow-role inverted from nourishment/protection into spectacle, captivity or extraction; not a standard religious term
cow_atlas.cash_cow: economic metaphor for reliable revenue stream; etymologically useful neighbor for lolcow's milk/extraction metaphor

cow_tree_relation.life_branch: Cow as nourishment/prosperity/protected life → milk/food/care → community reproduction → Tree of Life
cow_tree_relation.strife_branch: Lolcow as enclosure/extraction → provocation → reaction → clips/posts/archive → audience reward → more provocation → Tree of Strife
cow_tree_relation.formula: CowValue = nourishment_value - extraction_harm + symbolic/social output, with terms explicitly defined per domain
cow_tree_relation.project_insight: The cow is not inherently Life or Strife. The relation between Cow and Farmer determines whether the system cultivates, protects, milks sustainably, exploits, humiliates or destroys.

farm_graph.feedback: Reaction creates content; content attracts observers; observers reward Farmer/Dog roles; rewards increase observation/provocation; archive persistence creates future rediscovery.

ten_thousand_trees.meaning: 10,000 is treated as scale/plurality: not necessarily literally ten thousand websites or people, but an ecology capable of spawning many self-reproducing branches.
ten_thousand_trees.tree_seed: one humiliating/provocative interaction can seed a thread; thread seeds clips; clips seed memes; memes seed communities; communities seed norms; norms create new Farms
ten_thousand_trees.branching_model: N_(t+1)=R_eff N_t where R_eff is effective reproduction number of Strife branches

swamp_and_sektur.plane: ordinary plural society; multiple identities and exit routes
swamp_and_sektur.subculture: shared language/memes/norms; can be benign or creative
swamp_and_sektur.sektur: identity hardens; loyalty and enemy construction become central; dissent costs rise
swamp_and_sektur.swamp: many reinforcing institutions/communities/algorithms/archives create sticky path dependence
swamp_and_sektur.shadow_core: extreme zone where humiliation, threat, criminality or violence can become normalized

dogs_biblical_and_subcultural.biblical: Dogs can carry outsider/impurity/scavenger associations in biblical language; the Syrophoenician woman episode notably reworks the dog metaphor through wit and boundary-crossing inclusion.
dogs_biblical_and_subcultural.farm: Dog = patrol, bark, track, amplify, defend boundary, chase Cow, signal Farmer
dogs_biblical_and_subcultural.positive_counterrole: Guardian dog can protect Garden/flock; Dog is therefore a functional role whose moral valence depends on what it guards and how.
dogs_biblical_and_subcultural.beta_link: Dog often maps to Beta-like coordination/enforcement rather than top-level system orientation.

farm_vs_garden.garden: prepare soil → protect conditions → nourish → prune → allow autonomous growth → fruit/seed
farm_vs_garden.farmer_vs_gardener: Farmer in the shadow model optimizes harvest from subjects; Gardener optimizes conditions for subjects to become generative themselves.
farm_vs_garden.moloch_test: A system becomes Moloch-like when participants are incentivized to sacrifice long-term human flourishing for short-term competitive reward despite collectively worse outcomes.

research_questions: Can thread/post graphs empirically estimate R_eff for Strife propagation?
Which platform features make Cow→Farm cycles self-sustaining?
When does documentation serve accountability versus extraction/spectacle?
Which Dogs are guardians, which are amplifiers, and which switch roles by context?
Does anonymity increase hostile propagation after controlling for topic and group norms?
Can Tree-of-Life interventions reduce Strife reproduction by adding exit routes, friction, repair and prosocial prestige?
Which parts of the Josh/Moloch mapping are uniquely about Kiwi Farms and which describe generic multipolar attention traps?
